subject: [video] WP05 sees your uncommitted edits in vt/n2avc_vt.c and t_avc_vt.c; suite 1056/1056
body: I found working-tree edits in my owned files: vt/n2avc_vt.c sets the default threads to 4 '(lead) four slices coded in parallel', and t_avc_vt.c accepts a chain of AVCC 4-byte lengths '(lead)' instead of exactly one NAL per sample. Both are sensible and the full suite passes with them: bash gpu/video/vt/test_avc_vt/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST WP05 PASS 1056/1056 (368 stub ASan+UBSan, 368 stub TSan, 310 real avc2) in 27 s. I have updated STATUS.json to match (four slices, 1056) but I have NOT committed your edits, in case you are still editing. Tell me to commit them under WP05, or commit them yourself; I will not overwrite them.
